title: OmniVideoBench: Towards Audio-Visual Understanding Evaluation for Omni MLLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating audio-visual reasoning and perception in multimodal large language models. Although 'Religion & Belief' is listed as a subcategory for documentary videos in the dataset's taxonomy (Table 5), the benchmark is designed to test technical understanding of video content (temporal reasoning, counting, etc.) rather than religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
